display_long_description:
Roo Runners is a fun game made fore having fun causing chaos and more!

Feel free to customize your doggo as you like our cosmetics your style

Make sure to check out the Gamemodes That Are Out Right Now And Some Coming Soon (Not All Gamemodes Are Out On Realease)

Make sure to check our rules and code of conduct to figure out whats on 
the rules and whats not to make sure you follow the rules and wont face consequences!

This Game Has Been Built From The Ground Up Here Are Some Insane Helpers And Friends!

Thatguyfr - Hes been with me since the very begininng of roo runners!

Solkean - Making the model and being a nice and cool person to be around!

Axolotily - He Made Our Music And Map Come To Life And I Could'nt Thank Him Enough!

And To All The Players And Moderators On Our Mod Team

Jacko
Poptart
And Floyd
i see you :)

I hope you have a fun time playing: Roo Runners: Remastered!
